title: An-Nawawi's 40 Hadith
description: Study An-Nawawi's 40 Hadith, compiled by Imam Muhyi ad-Din Abu Zakariyya Yahya ibn Sharaf an-Nawawi (1233-1277 CE), a celebrated Islamic scholar from the Shafi'i school of jurisprudence. Born in the village of Nawa near Damascus, Imam an-Nawawi dedicated his short life to scholarship despite passing away at just 45 years old. This concise collection contains 42 hadiths (commonly referred to as '40' due to the Arabic tradition of rounding) that encompass the most fundamental principles of Islam. Imam an-Nawawi selected these hadiths after careful consideration, stating they represent the foundation of righteous practice.
short_description: Learn the essential hadiths compiled by Imam an-Nawawi on Sunnah.com
